title: The Practitioner's Guide to AgentOps - MachineLearningMastery.com

facts.fact: According to Futurum Research's 2025 market overview of agentic AI platforms, 89% of CIOs rank agent-based AI as a top strategic priority for productivity and workflow automation.
facts.quote: According to Futurum Research’s 2025 market overview of agentic AI platforms, [89% of CIOs now rank agent-based AI as a top strategic priority](https://zbrain.ai/agentops/) for productivity and workflow automation.

facts.fact: The article states that every mature AgentOps implementation rests on five operational capabilities: observability, evaluation, cost governance, safety and guardrails, and continuous improvement.
facts.quote: Every mature AgentOps implementation rests on five operational capabilities. They are not optional extras; they are the conditions under which agents can be trusted to run autonomously at any meaningful scale.

facts.fact: The article defines AgentOps as the set of practices, tools, and frameworks used to design, deploy, monitor, optimize, and govern autonomous AI agents in production.
facts.quote: AgentOps is the set of practices, tools, and frameworks used to design, deploy, monitor, optimize, and govern autonomous AI agents in production.

facts.fact: The article states that the vast majority of teams shipping agents in 2026 have no systematic way to understand why they fail, what they cost per session, or whether they stay within designed scope.
facts.quote: the vast majority of teams shipping agents in 2026 have no systematic way to understand why they fail, what they cost per session, or whether they are staying within the scope they were designed for.
